title: GNC Engineer - Reinforcement Learning
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. ABOUT THE ROLE Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of autonomous flight, where guidance and control requires intelligence. As a GNC Engineer - Reinforcement Learning, you will build AI models for autonomous guidance and control. You will push the frontier of performance and integrate learning based methods into real autonomous systems. RESPONSIBILITIES RL training pipeline: Plan, simulate and train reinforcement learning models for guidance and control, including obstacle avoidance, interceptor dynamics, perception and target aware planning. Model deployment and testing: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then flight test and improve. Performance Studies: Create tests to validate model robustness and performance. Including adversarial models. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers. CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS Educational Background: A Masters or PhD in Reinforcement Learning, Robotics, Automation and Control, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on sequential decision-making and autonomous systems. Deployment: Hands on experience building and deploying reinforcement learning agents. Deeply familiar with machine learning and reinforcement learning techniques. Hands on experience with MuJoCo, Pytorch, C++ Systems-minded and pragmatic about failure modes and imperfect inputs, disciplined about simulation and validation. Communicates clearly, able to present guidance and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. Bonus: Experience applying reinforcement learning techniques to drones or aircraft. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
